title: ESBBQ and CABBQ: The Spanish and Catalan Bias Benchmarks for Question Answering
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religion' as one of its ten core categories for social bias benchmarking. It features a dedicated section (B.3) discussing the adaptation of religious stereotypes to the Spanish context, specifically mentioning Catholicism and Islam, and provides quantitative performance and bias scores for the 'Religion' category in its evaluation results.
